code: /** * Feb-2026 · Batch #4 · Logo ship — tenant-scoped brand-logo helper. * * ``getTenantLogoUrl(company, tenant?)`` returns the src to plug * into an ```` on any doc surface (invoice / quote / * estimate / magic-link view / portal doc list). * * Resolution order (first non-empty wins): * 1. ``company.logo_url`` — explicit override coming back from * the ``_load_company`` payload the API emits. * 2. ``tenant.logo_url`` — future field a P2 admin-upload flow * will populate. * 3. ``DEFAULT_LOGO_URL`` — the Pool & Landscaping of Vistancia * mark shipped under ``/public/logos/``. Kept as a single * exported constant so the P2 upload flow only needs to * remove the fallback branch once tenants are seeded. * * The default resolves to the ``@1x`` optimized asset (16 KB) for * on-screen preview; the full-res 1024×1024 lives at * ``/logos/pool-landscaping-of-vistancia.png`` and is consumed by * the backend PDF renderer. */ export const DEFAULT_LOGO_URL = "/logos/pool-landscaping-of-vistancia@1x.png"; export function getTenantLogoUrl(company, tenant) { const co = company && company.logo_url || ""; const te = tenant && tenant.logo_url || ""; return co || te || DEFAULT_LOGO_URL; } export const DEFAULT_LOGO_ALT = "Pool & Landscaping of Vistancia";
